'''Soro''' is an [[Aiel]] of the ''[[Samma N'Sei]]''.

== History ==
[[Aviendha]] remembers him as a kind man, who learned to channel when he was a child, making ''[[algode]]'' grow where it should not. He was banished to the [[Blight]] due to suffering the [[Taint]] and expected to sacrifice his life fighting [[Shadowspawn]]; instead, he was turned to the ''[[Samma N'Sei]]'' like many male channelers of the Aiel.

== Activities ==
At the [[Last Battle]], Soro is killed by Aviendha and her [[Circle]] in [[Thakan'dar Valley]].{{ref/book|14|34}}

== Trivia ==
* Soro is named for Chris Beckman, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. His screen name was Soronhen Cirayher.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
